eve.ops: Postmortem follow-up: we still need owners for three DR cleanups after last week's failover: 1) brief traffic spike to eu-west (routing churn), 2) nightly snapshot flakiness on shard-09, 3) restore runbook missing validation steps. Please claim and give ETA.

ryan.sre: I'll take the routing churn. Quick hypothesis: health-check jitter + weight shifts. Plan: add lightweight per-request region tracing and a temporary cooldown before automated weight changes. ETA 72h.

kim.eng: I'll pick up shard-09 backups. Running isolated snapshot+restore in staging tonight to capture timings and failure mode. If it's I/O contention, propose moving snapshots or adding quiesce window. ETA 48h.

ana.pm: I'll update the restore runbook with explicit snapshot tag validation and a canary-promote flow. Will pair with @kim.eng for test steps. ETA 72h.

cron-bot: Saved alerts for reference: BACKUP_FAIL shard-09 (exit 23), ROUTE_SPIKE eu-west (20% traffic for ~3m).

ryan.sre: Note: route spikes align with our cross-region replication window on Thursdays 18:00-19:00 UTC. I'll add a flag to suppress weight rebalances during replication as part of mitigation.

kim.eng: Snapshot test plan: manual snapshot, restore to fresh instance, checksum compare, observe compaction interference. Will post logs and a remediation PR.

ana.pm: Runbook snippet I'll add: preflight list by tag, latest-timestamp check, sample hash compare, and canary restore steps.

eve.ops: Consolidated actions:
- ryan.sre: routing tracing + cooldown + replication suppression flag (ETA 72h)
- kim.eng: snapshot restore test + remediation PR (ETA 48h)
- ana.pm + kim.eng: runbook update + canary flow (ETA 72h)

eve.ops: I'll create a trackers page and schedule a dry-run once canaries are green. Reply here if you need to swap owners. :white_check_mark:
